name: Website Ventures Production Line v3

requiredFlow: Batch 5: agency desktop hero candidates -> choose one -> 4:5 mobile derivative
Batch 6: choose one recurring Plumbing technician
Promote only approved committed files through the Selected Assets registry; Review winner state alone never publishes
Verify selected media in the real Agency/Plumbing pages on desktop and mobile
Batch 9: final 4K masters only after winners
optionalFlow: Batch 8 agency support visuals are skip-by-default and never block progress

priorityOrder: P0 select agency hero + mobile derivative
P0 select recurring Plumbing technician + only needed same-person scenes
P0 promote approved files through Selected Assets and QA live agency + Plumbing demo on mobile/desktop
P2 one-character Gamenfy animation technology pilot when Website Ventures generation is not the active bottleneck
hardRules: Joey manually runs the active Higgsfield queue on higgsfield.ai; do not spend connector credits just because a prompt exists.
Unlimited exploration is preferred where the selected website model supports it.
At 50% remaining paid-generation balance, stop new paid work and review winners, waste and remaining required jobs.
No final 4K generation before a 2K still winner exists.
A local Review winner checkbox is QA state only; it never makes an asset live.
A page may replace its coded placeholder only when the intended Selected Assets registry slot is status=selected and selectedPath points to a real committed file.
Missing/pending/failed selected media must fail safely back to the coded placeholder rather than breaking the page.
Joey's own agency website sets the visual/technical ceiling before customer templates are pushed further.
Agency site demonstrates craft primarily through its coded experience, one strong hero system and real showcase captures; it must not become an AI-image gallery.
Batch 8 support visuals are optional and skip-by-default until a real coded section demonstrates a media need.
Plumbing remains the first customer showcase, not the public top-level Website Ventures identity.
Generated demo visuals may never masquerade as completed client work, reviews, certifications or measured outcomes.
Internal prompts, model recipes, production logic and asset registries are competitive IP and must not be exposed on the public agency site.
Gamenfy Park 3.1 evolution inventory is preserved; do not regenerate existing 13 x 10 evolution sets by default.
For Gamenfy, prove real character movement with one approved source character before expanding to props, parks or skill packs.
All unapproved v2 Plumbing scene concepts and full Gamenfy park/object concepts remain hypotheses, not production requirements.

agencyNarrativeHypothesis.principle: The website itself demonstrates the quality and interaction Joey sells.
flow: Hero: immediate premium visual/interaction proof with one clear promise hypothesis
First-scroll payoff: the hero/system responds so capability is experienced, not described
Plumbing showcase: real desktop + mobile demo captures as first proof-of-craft
Transformation demo: coded before/after or ordinary-to-premium interactive comparison
Reusable premium interaction demo: code-first commercial add-on technology experiment
Offer/starting-price section: clear but still editable while pricing is tested
agencyNarrativeHypothesis.mobileRule: Every wow interaction must have a deliberate mobile version; no desktop-only proof.

agencyBatches.name: Agency structure + design-system lock
agencyBatches.definitionOfDone: The coded showroom establishes narrative, spacing, type hierarchy, motion rhythm and mobile structure so generated assets can be inserted without redesigning the whole page.

assets.input: calm premium shell, strong typography, controlled spacing, restrained palette, interaction-led sections
assets.gate: Feels expensive without relying on stock imagery; mobile still feels intentional; future winners can slot in cleanly.

assets.input: hero -> first-scroll proof -> plumbing showcase -> transformation -> premium interaction -> offer -> credibility -> CTA
assets.gate: Each section has one job and one visual slot; no duplicate agency-copy sections.
No horizontal overflow; text remains readable; sticky/scroll experiences retain their intended payoff on mobile.

agencyBatches.name: Agency exact visual slots
agencyBatches.definitionOfDone: Generated media is limited to slots with a real page job. External media is not added merely to decorate sections.

assets.gate: Strong without copy; stable negative space; first frame sells premium quality; mobile and desktop clearly belong to one campaign.

assets.input: real captures of the actual Premium Plumbing demo plus its approved visuals
assets.format: desktop browser frame + mobile device frame + live-link presentation
assets.gate: Clearly presented as a demo/showcase until a real customer exists; proves desktop and mobile craft.
assets.generationRule: Do not generate duplicate agency-specific fake screens.

assets.format: coded slider/scrub/scroll state with replaceable visual inputs
assets.gate: Interaction explains value in under 5 seconds; works with touch and keyboard; does not depend on fabricated client evidence.
assets.generationRule: Code/screenshot first; Batch 8 visual only if this fails without media.

assets.destination: agency R&D showcase / future paid add-on
assets.format: coded interaction first; optional visual assets later
assets.gate: Feels meaningfully premium rather than decorative; reusable in a customer site; mobile fallback remains impressive.
assets.generationRule: No separate asset until the interaction technology itself passes.

assets.input: working hypothesis €349 founding / later €499-€699, not yet final
assets.gate: Final price language matches deliverable scope.
Every proof claim can be traced to a real customer or measurable fact.

plumbingShowcase.role: first major showroom demo and first commercial customer template system
fixed: authentic tradesperson rather than fashion model
plumbingShowcase.nextGate: Integrate the selected recurring technician and small working-scene set through the Selected Assets registry into the actual Plumbing demo, then judge what additional scene is genuinely missing before generating more.

gamenfyAnimationPilot.sourceRule: Use one existing approved character. Do not generate a new skill character for this test.

tests.target: legs and arms change frame-by-frame; no sliding-flat-image illusion
tests.preferredWorkflow: AutoSprite walk from one approved character source
tests.gate: Feet contact stable, identity stable, body does not morph, loop reads as real walking at app size.
Subtle breathing/weight shift/blink style motion without jitter or identity drift.
Clear anticipation, airborne pose and landing; not a vertical translation of a flat cutout.

tests.preferredWorkflow: one simple existing/temporary prop + custom sprite/CSS/FX
tests.gate: Character appears to physically interact with the prop; proves layering architecture before object batching.

gamenfyAnimationPilot.fallbackArchitectureGate: If the above cannot feel genuinely alive after a bounded pilot, stop paid animation batching and prototype rigged 2D limbs/joints (Rive/Spine-style architecture) instead.

beforeHiggsfieldPurchase: ACTIVE SPRINT: use the live Higgsfield Queue rather than old v2/P0 manifests.
Generate manually on higgsfield.ai for Unlimited-supported exploration jobs.
Use Review winners to record scores/defects and select approved candidates before dependent jobs.
Remember: Review selection does not publish; promote committed winners only through Selected Assets.
Keep Batch 8 optional; do not generate support images until the coded page proves a need.
At 50% of paid credits remaining, stop and review before any further paid generation.
Keep final 4K masters and motion blocked until still/reference winners are approved.
